custom_logic_notes: EA uses XOSignal custom indicator for signal generation and ColorZerolagXOSignal for confirmation. The 'ReOpen' in the name indicates it will re-open a position in the same direction after a stop loss if the trend signal persists. SL and TP levels come from the XOSignal indicator buffers rather than fixed pip values. The EA handles 5-digit broker adjustment by multiplying SL/TP by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001. Position management includes closing opposite positions before entering new ones and re-opening same-direction positions on continued signals.
python_conversion_notes: Requires implementing XOSignal and ColorZerolagXOSignal custom indicator logic in Python since these are not built-in MT5 indicators. The XOSignal appears to be a zero-lag smoothing oscillator - need to reverse-engineer the indicator algorithm from its .mq5 source if available. The ColorZerolagXOSignal likely combines multiple XOSignal instances with different periods for trend coloring. SL/TP are dynamically set from indicator buffers, not fixed pips, so the indicator must be fully replicated. The ReOpen logic (re-entering after SL hit while trend continues) requires careful state tracking in Python.
